{{Top|leg}}
'''Semaphore''' was a visual [[Language/Legends|language]] used to send messages by sight rather than sound. The [[Signal Corps]], part of the militarized government of [[Alanciar]], a continent on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], used [[fireglobe]]s to transmit messages in semaphore from tower-like structures known as [[signal station]]s.
